connector.name: Twitterapi
connector.registryDescription: Read/write X (Twitter) via twitterapi.io: mentions, thread context, create and delete tweets.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package twitterapi.mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pedrot95dev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TWITTERAPI_IO_KEY
env.description: twitterapi.io API key (x-api-key). Required for all tools.

env.name: TWITTERAPI_IO_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: auth_token cookie from a logged-in X session. Write tools only.

env.name: TWITTERAPI_IO_CT0
env.description: ct0 cookie from the same logged-in X session. Write tools only.
